anomalies.observed: On the Thermocouples sheet the SO (MISO) pin 7 of all three MAX31855KASA devices (U10, U11, U3) is driven onto the shared net NET0019, but NET0019 does not appear anywhere on the Microcontroller sheet. Conversely the ESP32-C3 (U2) pin labeled GPIO10 carries the net NET0010, and NET0010 does not appear on the Thermocouples sheet. The SCK net (NET0015) and the three CS nets (NET0011/NET0008/NET0006) are present on both sheets, so only the MISO/SO path is broken.

The thermocouple SO net must connect to the ESP32 MISO GPIO (GPIO10); the same net name must appear on both sheets.

anomalies.impact: The SPI MISO line is disconnected: the ESP32 cannot read the thermocouple data word from any of the three MAX31855 chips. Temperature sensing is dead, so every zone will report a fault/zero reading and the bang-bang heater control cannot operate correctly (the firmware's ThermocoupleFault path would trip).

parsed.summary: The drawing matches the spec on power arbitration, buck regulation, the high-side heater switch, fan-tach TVS protection, and the SPI SCK/CS nets, but the thermocouple SPI MISO net is broken: the shared SO net (NET0019) on the three MAX31855s never reaches the ESP32, whose GPIO10 instead carries an orphan net (NET0010). This open connection would prevent all temperature reading.
